assertions.title: Full pipeline end-to-end

steps.expected: Valid YAML file with species configs

steps.action: Extract human-only config and build database via References.from_yaml() + make_airr_database()
steps.observed: BLAST Database creation error: local id is too long (185 chars, max 50). Fails at _make_internal_annotaion_file -> make_blast_db_for_internal -> write_blast_db

steps.observed: Could not reach this step — database build failed

evidence.consoleErrors: RuntimeError: BLAST Database creation error: Near line 1571, the local id is too long. Its length is 185 but the maximum allowed local id length is 50.

assertions.issues: The generated reference YAML produces allele IDs that exceed BLAST's 50-character limit for local IDs. This occurs even when filtering to human-only config. The pipeline generate_reference_yaml() → References.from_yaml() → make_airr_database() fails at the internal BLAST DB creation step. Also: References.from_yaml() does not support a name_filter parameter as assumed by the test script — it loads all species in the YAML.

steps.expected: Test passes — Airr with IMGT default providers annotates correctly

evidence.consoleErrors: none (only deprecation warnings from Biopython and pandas)

steps.expected: Test passes — cache is invalidated when reference config changes

frictions.description: References.from_yaml() does not accept a name_filter parameter — the test script provided by the parent agent assumed this existed. Had to adjust to generate a human-only YAML manually.
frictions.resolution: Created a human-only YAML by extracting just the 'human' key from the full config and writing it to a separate file.

frictions.description: Even with human-only config, the generated reference YAML produces gene IDs that exceed BLAST's 50-character local ID limit (185 chars found). This prevents make_airr_database() from completing.

blockers.description: BLAST Database creation fails with 'local id is too long' error (185 chars vs 50 max) when building from auto-generated reference YAML. The gene IDs produced by generate_reference_yaml() through the germlines module path (use_germlines=True) are too long for BLAST's internal database format. This blocks the full end-to-end pipeline flow (generate → build → annotate).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Tried filtering to human-only species config to reduce complexity — same error persists because the issue is gene ID string length, not number of species.

summary: Tested 3 assertions: 2 passed (VAL-CROSS-002, VAL-CROSS-003), 1 failed (VAL-CROSS-001: BLAST ID length overflow when building database from auto-generated reference YAML)
